# kea_dhcp4_client_class (Data Source)

Retrieves a DHCPv4 client class from the Kea DHCP server.

**Important:** Requires the `class_cmds` hook library.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a client class by name
data "kea_dhcp4_client_class" "voip" {
  name = "voip-phones"
}

output "voip_test" {
  value = data.kea_dhcp4_client_class.voip.test
}

output "voip_options" {
  value = data.kea_dhcp4_client_class.voip.option_data
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the client class.

### Read-Only

- `boot_file_name` (String) Boot file name for network booting (`file` field in DHCP packet, Option 67).
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the client class, equal to its name.
- `max_valid_lifetime` (Number) Maximum lease lifetime in seconds a client in this class can request.
- `min_valid_lifetime` (Number) Minimum lease lifetime in seconds a client in this class can request.
- `next_server` (String) Next server address for network booting (`siaddr` field in DHCP packet).
- `only_in_additional_list` (Boolean) Whether the class is only evaluated when listed in `evaluate-additional-classes`.
- `option_data` (Attributes Set) DHCP options configured for this client class. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--option_data))
- `option_def` (Attributes List) Custom option definitions of this client class. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--option_def))
- `server_hostname` (String) Server hostname for network booting (`sname` field in DHCP packet).
- `template_test` (String) Expression whose result names a subclass the client is assigned to.
- `test` (String) Expression that a client must match to belong to this class.
- `user_context` (String) Arbitrary JSON data stored with this client class.
- `valid_lifetime` (Number) Lease lifetime in seconds for clients in this class.

<a id="nestedatt--option_data"></a>
### Nested Schema for `option_data`

Read-Only:

- `always_send` (Boolean) Whether this option is always sent to the client.
- `client_classes` (Set of String) Client classes for which this option applies.
- `code` (Number) Option code.
- `csv_format` (Boolean) Whether data is in CSV format (`true`) or raw format (`false`).
- `data` (String) Option value.
- `name` (String) Option name.
- `never_send` (Boolean) Whether this option is never sent to the client.
- `space` (String) Option space.


<a id="nestedatt--option_def"></a>
### Nested Schema for `option_def`

Read-Only:

- `array` (Boolean) Whether the option carries an array of values of `type`.
- `code` (Number) Option code.
- `encapsulate` (String) Option space encapsulated by this option.
- `name` (String) Option name.
- `record_types` (String) Comma-separated field types when `type` is `record`.
- `space` (String) Option space.
- `type` (String) Option data type.
